meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: Claude 会按你的要求重新应用已安装的技能：先检测仓库里有哪些 channel/provider 技能，让你勾选要更新的，再逐个执行其自带的安装流程，从上游拉取最新代码覆盖旧文件，并用构建和测试验证。
howto.when: 当你说要更新技能或运行 /update-skills 时触发；前提是当前工作区没有未提交改动，且配置了上游仓库。

say.text: 把已安装的技能全部更新到最新版本
say.note: Claude 会列出技能让你勾选后逐个更新。

say.text: 只更新 Slack 技能，其他不动
say.note: 只对 Slack 重新执行安装并拉取更新。
直接进入技能更新流程，先做检查。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude re-applies your installed skills: it detects channel/provider skills, lets you pick which to refresh, re-runs each skill's own apply step to fetch latest code from upstream, then validates with build and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say you want to update skills or run /update-skills, provided the working tree is clean and an upstream remote is configured.

say_en.text: Update all installed skills to the latest version
say_en.note: Claude will list the skills and refresh them one by one.

say_en.text: Only update the Slack skill, leave the rest
say_en.note: Re-applies just Slack and pulls its latest code.
Starts the update flow after a preflight check.
